newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba SC sees most shares in Swiss hands.
newsitem.headline: Ciba SC sees most shares in Swiss hands.

text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding Inc Chairman Rolf Meyer said he expected most of the company's stock to be owned by Swiss shareholders and declined to comment on the shares' likely performance.

"My rough estimate would be that we may have over 50 percent Swiss shareholders, some 20 percent or thereabouts in the U.K., maybe 10 to 15 percent in the U.S. and the rest would be continental Europe and the rest of the world," he told Reuters by telephone after the company priced its global offering at 110 Swiss francs. "But obviously that can still change."
He declined to comment directly when asked what he expected shares to do when they start trading today on the Swiss Exchange and SEAQ International.
"That is up to the market," he said.

He said Ciba SC, spun off from Novartis in a complex rights issue, planned to report first-quarter results and unveil its opening balance sheet in early May. He declined to comment on business developments so far in 1997.
